verdicts.short_answer: YES, on all three routes and on a fourth. A component declaring ['Read','Grep','Glob'] spawned a subprocess, opened a socket, wrote outside its own root, and invoked a wider-permission sibling - 4 of 4, while the wide-permission control ran unimpeded. The reason is structural, not a bug: no runtime component reads a declared permission set at all. tool_permissions is metadata.

Verify with python command-center/casualty/verify_elided_digest.py <this file>, which also runs a both-states control.
